name: Johan Van Overtveldt - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the European Central Bank – annual report 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on the European Central Bank's work in 2025. It says the bank must stay independent from politics but be more open about how it decides things. It wants the bank to keep inflation near 2%, wind down its government bond buying, and be careful about cutting interest rates too fast. It also raises the digital euro, crypto oversight, cash, and the bank's recent losses. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. Parliament gives recommendations and asks the bank to explain more and shrink bond purchases.
- **Who it affects:** The European Central Bank, euro-area banks and governments, and people using the euro.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council and Commission; the bank is not obliged to act on it.
